overview.title: 考情总览
overview.lead: 每格代表 10% 的试卷；教材进度加粗，表示考查早于教学。
overview.after: 时态、被动语态每卷都考，初中已学，见同步讲义，本册不单列。快的学校期中前已教到必修一 U5。倒装期中 3 成卷考，期末升到近 7 成。

topics.name: 非谓语

explain.text: 作状语
分词作状语最常见，如 Compared with、Burying himself。分词与逻辑主语是主动关系时用 -ing，是被动关系时用 -ed（compared 指被比较）。
不定式作目的状语，动词用原形，如 to establish、to promote。句意是“为了”时，可以试换成 in order to。
作宾语与搭配
动词后的 to 与 -ing 由搭配决定：pretend、attempt、need 接不定式；spend time、be addicted to、lead to 接动名词。
remember、stop、try 后接 to 与 -ing 意思不同，要结合句意判断，不能只看形式。
形式判断
空前有 to 或介词时，看 to 的性质：作不定式符号的 to 后用原形（breathe、make up、comment on），作介词的 to 后用 -ing（addicted to smoking）。
-ed 常见于 with 复合结构，如 with her bike stolen。作主语、作定语各 4 题，形式同上，不单列。
be worth doing  |  prefer doing to doing  |  with sth. done

stem.text: ___ (compare) with people living in Palestine, our life is much happier and safer.
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 与住在巴勒斯坦的人相比，我们的生活更幸福、更安全。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 句中已有谓语 is，空处作状语。逻辑主语 our life 与 compare 是被动关系，用过去分词，句首要大写。

stem.text: The old man has been addicted to ___ (smoke) for 60 years.
stem.src: 2024 · 松山湖未来 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 这位老人吸烟上瘾已有 60 年了。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: be addicted to 中的 to 是介词，后面接动名词作宾语，不接不定式。

stem.text: It is no use ___ (complain) without taking any action.
stem.src: 2022 · 第五高中 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 抱怨而不采取行动是没有用的。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: It is no use doing sth. 固定句型，动名词作真主语，complain 用 -ing。

topics.keypoint: 句中已有谓语且无连词时，空处多为非谓语作状语或定语；空前是 to 或介词，按搭配选形式。主动用 -ing 或 to 原形，被动用 -ed 或 to be done。

drill.stem: Sometimes the little boy pretended ___ (read) a book on the sofa to make his parents praise him.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上期中
drill.why: pretend 后接不定式作宾语。

drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中

drill.stem: Because he buried himself in his book, he was not aware it was raining outside.
drill.src: 2022 · 翰林 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Burying himself in his book, he was not aware it was raining outside.

drill.stem: But ___ (spend) too much time online is unhealthy and makes it very difficult to focus on other things in life.
drill.src: 2023 · 莞美、大岭山中学、大朗佳美 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 动名词作主语，谓语用单数。

drill.stem: He spends a lot of time ___ (revise) his notes to ensure he understands everything.
drill.src: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中

drill.stem: She had to walk home with her bike ___ (steal).
drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: with + 名词 + 过去分词（被偷）。

topics.name: it 形式主宾语

explain.text: 形式宾语 it
find、make、consider 等动词后，若真正的宾语是不定式或 that 从句，用 it 占位，it 不译。
it 与真宾之间是宾补：make it clear that（说清楚）、make it a rule that（定为规定）、find it difficult to do（觉得难做）。
形式主语 It

lines: 常由副词或 seems 改写

explain.text: 句首 It 作形式主语，真主语是后置的不定式或 that 从句。obvious、clear 后接 that；difficult、hard 后接 to do（前面可有 for sb.）。that 后必须是完整句。
改写题常见两种：Obviously … → It is obvious that …；sb. seems to do → It seems that …（时态跟原句）。
find / make / consider it adj. to do  |  It is adj. that …

stem.text: The teacher made ___ clear that our credits would be hard-earned.
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 老师明确表示，我们的学分是来之不易的。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: make 后空处作宾语，it 为形式宾语，真正的宾语是 that 从句；clear 是宾补。

stem.text: I consider ___ an honor to be able to see the bird.
stem.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 我认为能看到这只鸟是一种荣幸。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: consider 后空处作形式宾语，指代后面的 to be able to see the bird；an honor 是宾补。

stem.text: Obviously, the new policy has improved efficiency, unlike the previous one. → ___ the new policy has improved efficiency, unlike the previous one.
stem.src: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 显而易见，这项新政策相比以往的政策提升了效率。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 副词 Obviously 改为 It is obvious that：It 作形式主语，that 从句是真正的主语。

topics.keypoint: it 在宾语位置且后接形容词时，是形式宾语，真正的宾语在后；it 在句首接 be adj.，真主语在句末，看后置的是 to 还是 that。

drill.stem: The research reveals that teenagers find ___ difficult to concentrate on their study after playing mobile games continuously for an hour.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: find it + adj. + to do 为固定结构。

drill.stem: Our school has made ___ a rule that every student shall wear uniforms at school.
drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: make it a rule that 定为规定。

drill.stem: 显然，现在越来越多青少年沉迷手机游戏。
cue: 用it 作形式主语翻译句子
drill.src: 2024 · 第八高中 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It is obvious that more and more teenagers are addicted to mobile games nowadays.
drill.why: obvious 接 that 从句。

drill.stem: Going from junior high school to senior high school is a really big challenge.
cue: 用it作形式主语改写句子
drill.src: 2024 · 松山湖未来 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It is a really big challenge to go from junior high school to senior high school.
drill.why: 长主语后置，to 不定式作真主语。

drill.stem: It’s difficult for us ___ (organize) our ideas at that dangerous time.
drill.src: 2024 · 第四高中 · 高一上期中
drill.why: difficult 接 for sb. to do。

drill.stem: 对我来说，习惯高中生活不难。
drill.src: 2023 · 莞美、大岭山中学、大朗佳美 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It’s not difficult for me to get used to the life of high school.
drill.why: 也可用 As for me 开头。

topics.name: 定语从句

explain.text: 关系副词
关系词在从句里作状语时才用关系副词：地点用 where，时间用 when，原因用 why（先行词 the reason 最常见）。
翻译题里“……的日子”常译作 the days when …，也可用 in which。
the reason why …  |  the place where …  |  the time when …
关系代词
从句缺主语或宾语：指人用 who（作主语）、whom（作宾语），指物用 which 或 that，所属关系用 whose（如 whose windows）。
介词后用“介词 + whom / which”，如 with whom；that 不能跟在介词后。逗号后的 which、whom、whose 是非限定，前面用逗号隔开，不能换成 that。
合并句子
两句合成一句时，找出两句共有的名词作先行词，把第二句里与它有关的词换成关系词，放在先行词之后。
合并题的关系词按先行词选：指人 who、whom、whose，指物 which、that，指地点 where。

stem.text: Your performance at the discussion gave me a deep impression and that’s the reason ___ I want you.
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 你在讨论会上的表现给我留下了深刻的印象，这就是我需要你的原因。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 空处引导定语从句修饰 the reason；从句 I want you 中，why 作原因状语。

stem.text: After successfully winning the right to host the 2022 Winter Olympics, Beijing will become the world’s first city ___ hosts both Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics.
stem.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 在成功获得 2022 年冬奥会举办权后，北京将成为世界上第一个同时举办夏季奥运会和冬季奥运会的城市。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 先行词 city 指物，在从句 hosts 中作主语，用 that；first 修饰 city。

stem.text: The boy was rushed to the hospital. The boy’s leg was seriously injured in the accident.
stem.src: 2022 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 男孩被紧急送往医院，他的腿在事故中受了重伤。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 第二句的 leg 与先行词 The boy 是所属关系，改为 whose leg，放在 The boy 之后。

examples.ans: The boy whose leg was seriously injured in the accident was rushed to the hospital.

topics.keypoint: 从句缺状语时用 where、when、why；缺主语或宾语时用 who、whom、which、that；所属关系用 whose。逗号后是非限定，不能用 that。

drill.stem: Sales director is a position ___ communication ability is just as important as sales skills.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 地点状语在从句中，用 where。

drill.stem: 我永远也不会忘记我们一起在高中读书的日子。
cue: 使用定语从句翻译句子
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: I’ll never forget the days when we studied together in high school.
drill.why: 时间先行词用 when 或 in which。

drill.stem: The destination ___ is marked on the map as a “must-see” spot attracts thousands of tourists annually.
drill.src: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 指物，在从句中作主语。

drill.stem: I live next door to a couple ___ children often make a lot of noise.
drill.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: whose 修饰从句主语 children。

drill.stem: The man with ___ you shook hands just now is our headmaster.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: with 后用 whom，指人。

drill.stem: 只有勇敢面对挑战的人才能成功。
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Only those who face challenges bravely can succeed.
drill.why: those who 引导定语从句。

drill.stem: The Smiths have two children, both of ___ work in New York.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: both of 后用 whom，指人。

drill.stem: The student’s calligraphy work was shown on the blackboard. I know the student.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: I know the student whose calligraphy work was shown on the blackboard.
drill.why: 第二句的 calligraphy 所属 student，用 whose。

topics.name: 强调句

explain.text: It is/was…that

lines: 去掉框架后仍是完整句

explain.text: 结构是 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that（指人可用 who）+ 其余部分。被强调的可以是主语、宾语或状语；强调宾语时结构相同，只是被强调的是宾语。
时态看原句：原句一般过去时，强调句用 was；原句一般现在时，用 is。
not until 强调
原句“直到……才……”改写为 It was not until + 时间成分 + that + 其余句子；that 后接原来的主句，时态不变。
It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分

stem.text: In 2016，Coach Lang Ping led her volleyball team to Olympic gold in Brazil.
cue: 改为强调地点状语的强调句
stem.src: 2024 · 第八高中 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 2016 年，正是在巴西，郎平教练率女排夺得了奥运会金牌。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 被强调的是地点状语 in Brazil（回答 where），时间 in 2016 仍留在句中，时态用一般过去时。

examples.ans: It was in Brazil that Coach Lang Ping led her volleyball team to Olympic gold in 2016.

stem.text: He did not realize the value of health until he fell seriously ill.
stem.src: 2022 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 直到得了重病，他才意识到健康的价值。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: not until he fell seriously ill 是被强调部分，that 后接原主句 he realized the value of health，时态不变。

examples.ans: It was not until he fell seriously ill that he realized the value of health.

topics.keypoint: 被强调的成分可以是时间、地点、原因，也可以是人或物，套入 It is/was…that；去掉 It is…that 后句子须完整。not until 整体放进 It was 与 that 之间。

drill.stem: Remember, whenever you travel abroad, it is your country ___ you are representing.
drill.src: 2023 · 第十中学 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 强调宾语 your country，指物用 that。

drill.stem: 正是在你的帮助下，我的英语口语才取得了这么大的进步。
drill.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It is with your help that I have made such great progress in my spoken/oral English.
drill.why: 强调介词短语 with your help。

drill.stem: People in modern times didn’t know about the Terracotta statues until 1974. → It was ___ 1974 ___ people in modern times knew about the Terracotta statues.
drill.src: 2023 · 东华 · 高一上期中
drill.why: not until…that 固定句型。

drill.stem: I recognized him in the crowd [_when I was walking in the street_].
drill.src: 2022 · 第五高中 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It was when I was walking in the street that I recognized him in the crowd.
drill.why: when 从句强调，时态不变。

drill.stem: [_Because she sat too long in front of the computer_], her eyes suffered.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It was because she sat too long in front of the computer that her eyes suffered.
drill.why: 强调原因状语从句，用 It was…that。

drill.stem: He didn’t make the team [_until he won the match_].
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It was not until he won the match that he made the team.
drill.why: not until 整体放入强调部分。

topics.name: 虚拟语气

explain.text: recommend 型

lines: 建议要求类 that 从句用虚拟

explain.text: recommend、suggest（表建议）、request、demand、propose 等表示“建议、要求”的动词，后面的 that 从句谓语用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可省，原形不能丢。
从句主语是动作的承受者，用被动：(should) be done，如 attention should be focused。把 recommend sb. to do 改写时，换成 recommend that sb. (should) do。
as if 从句表示与过去事实相反，谓语用 had + 过去分词。
recommend / request that sb. (should) do  |  …that sth. (should) be done

stem.text: The doctor recommended that my brother ___ (give) up smoking.

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: recommend 后的 that 从句用虚拟，谓语为 (should) + 动词原形；give up 是动词短语，原形不带 -s。

stem.text: Our teachers request that attention ___ (focus) on the lessons in class.
stem.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 我们的老师要求在课堂上把注意力集中在课文上。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: request 后 that 从句用虚拟；attention 与 focus 是被动关系，用 (should) be focused。

topics.keypoint: 见 recommend、request 等建议要求类动词，that 从句写 (should) + 原形；主语是物再加 be done。把 recommend sb. to do 换成 recommend that sb. (should) do。

drill.stem: Our head teacher recommends that we ___ (attend) the lecture to be given this weekend.
drill.src: 2023 · 莞美、大岭山中学、大朗佳美 · 高一上期中
drill.why: should 可省，动词用原形。

drill.stem: Palestinians have long demanded that refugees (难民) ___ (permit) to return home.
drill.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: permit 与 refugees 是被动关系。

drill.stem: Mary likes dancing and her adviser recommended she ___ (报名) a ballet course.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 报名即 sign up for，用原形。

drill.stem: Mrs Brown 建议他积极参加课外活动。
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Mrs Brown recommended that he (should) take part in after-class activities actively.
drill.why: recommend that 从句用虚拟。

drill.stem: The committee proposed that the government ___ (调查原因) why so many wild animals disappeared.
drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: propose 表建议，从句用虚拟。

drill.stem: My English teacher recommends me to exchange learning methods with my classmates.
drill.src: 2024 · 第八高中 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: My English teacher recommends that I (should) exchange learning methods with my classmates.
drill.why: recommend sb. to do 改为 that 从句。

drill.stem: Jack wasn't saying anything, but the teacher smiled at him as if he ___ (do) something very clever.
drill.src: 2022 · 翰林 · 高一上期中
drill.why: as if 从句与过去事实相反。

topics.name: 状语从句

explain.text: 让步

lines: no matter 或 even 开头

explain.text: no matter + 疑问词（what、where）表示“无论”，相当于 -ever 词；句首的 No matter what 首字母大写。
even if 表示“即使”（假设），even though 表示“尽管”（事实），两者不能互换。
结果
so + 形容词或副词 + that，such + 名词短语 + that，that 后接结果，如 so interesting that（有趣到……）。
so that 也可表目的（以便）。看句意：“如此……以至”是结果，“为了……”是目的。时间（until、once）、原因（because）各 1 题，不单列。
no matter what / where + 从句  |  so + adj. + that + 从句

stem.text: Whatever you meet with in the future, I will spare no effort to help you. → ___ you meet with in the future, I will spare no effort to help you.

examples.ju: 无论你在未来遇到什么，我都会不遗余力地帮助你。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: Whatever 引导让步状语从句，可改写为 no matter what，从句作主句的状语，句首大写。

stem.text: The greenhouse effect is becoming so serious ___ we must take some actions to deal with it.
stem.src: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 温室效应正变得如此严重，我们必须采取一些行动来应对它。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: so serious 后接 that 引导结果状语从句，是固定句型，表示“如此……以至于……”。

topics.keypoint: 连接词看三处：no matter + 疑问词表“无论”，even if 表假设，even though 表事实。so 或 such 后接 that 时，判断是结果还是“以便”的目的。

drill.stem: ___ (尽管) my grandfather is in his nineties, he still plays tennis now and then.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 尽管表事实，用 even though。

drill.stem: ___ (即使) you plant the seed upside down, the roots will still grow down.
drill.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 即使表假设，用 even if。

drill.stem: But ___ (无论哪里) they looked, the results were always the same.
drill.src: 2024 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.why: no matter + 疑问词表无论。

drill.stem: My English classes are so interesting ___ I am fond of them.
drill.src: 2024 · 第四高中 · 高一上期中
drill.why: so…that 引导结果状语从句。

drill.stem: 球重重地打在他身上，使他差点儿落入水中。
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
drill.why: so hard that 表结果。

drill.stem: I hadn’t realized she was Miss Liu ___ she spoke. (用适当的词填空)
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: not…until 直到……才……。

drill.stem: Many students lost marks in the exam simply ___ they didn’t read the questions carefully. (用适当的词填空)
drill.src: 2023 · 莞美、大岭山中学、大朗佳美 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 两句间是因果关系。

topics.name: 名词性从句

explain.text: 主语从句
句首的 that 从句或 what 从句作主语。It is obvious、likely 后接 that 从句，It 是形式主语，that 从句是真主语。
What 引导的主语从句在从句内部作成分，如 What impressed me most 中 what 作 impressed 的主语；主句谓语看后面的名词单复数。
宾语从句多见 about what 这类介词后缺宾语；recommend 类宾语从句归专题 5，此处不重复。
It is likely that …  |  It seems that …

stem.text: ___ impressed me most were the amazing waterfalls in Jiuzhaigou.
stem.src: 2022 · 第五高中 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 给我留下最深印象的是九寨沟令人惊叹的瀑布。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 句首的空引导主语从句，在从句中作 impressed 的主语，所以用 what；谓语 were 与后面的 waterfalls 一致。

stem.text: The survey shows people are confused about ___ they should eat to stay healthy.
stem.src: 2024 · 第八高中 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 一项调查表明，人们对保持健康该吃什么感到困惑。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: about 后是介词，之后是宾语从句；从句的 eat 缺宾语，what 同时引导从句并作 eat 的宾语。

topics.keypoint: 从句在句中作主语时，常转成 It be adj. that 句型；动词或介词后缺成分时，用 what 引导。

drill.stem: They are likely to be fired by the company because of their faults. → ___ they will be fired by the company because of their faults.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中
drill.why: likely 接 that 从句，It 作形式主语。

drill.stem: He seems to know everything. → ___ he knows everything.
drill.src: 2022 · 翰林 · 高一上期中
drill.why: seem to do 改为 It seems that。

drill.stem: Obviously, the ability to talk is something that marks humans off from animals. → ___ the ability to talk is something that marks humans off from animals.
drill.src: 2024 · 第四高中 · 高一上期中
drill.why: Obviously 改为 It is obvious that。

drill.stem: Obviously, the manager is satisfied with the guy’s arrangement. → ___ the manager is satisfied with the guy’s arrangement.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: Obviously 改为 It is obvious that。

drill.stem: 似乎越来越多的青少年已经很沉迷于网络游戏。
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It seems that more and more teenagers have been addicted to (playing) online games.
drill.why: as if 与 that 皆可，It 作形式主语。

topics.name: 倒装

explain.text: 否定词句首
否定词 not only、never 放句首时，句子部分倒装：助动词、情态动词或 be 提到主语前，其余实义动词位置不变。
只倒助动词，不倒后面的 but also 从句，如 Not only did she achieve …（did 在前，achieve 用原形）。
only + 状语（介词短语或从句）放句首时，主句用 can、did 等助动词提到主语前；only 修饰主语时不倒装。
表地点或方位的状语放句首，谓语是 be 或不及物动词、主语是名词时全部倒装；主语是代词时不倒。
Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形 …  |  Only + 状语 + 助动词 + 主语 …

stem.text: She not only achieved her dream but also set a good example for us. → Not only ___ her dream but also she set a good example for us.

examples.ju: 她不仅实现了她的梦想，而且为我们树立了一个好榜样。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: not only 位于句首，助动词 did 提到主语 she 之前，实义动词 achieve 恢复原形；but also 后的 she 不倒装。

stem.text: The speaker stood in front of the students of Grade one. → In front of the students of Grade one ___.
stem.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上期中

examples.ju: 演讲者站在一年级学生面前。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 表方位的介词短语置于句首，主语 the speaker 是名词，谓语 stood 不及物，全部倒装到主语前。

topics.keypoint: 句首是否定词或 only + 状语时，把助动词、情态动词或 be 提到主语前；句首是地点状语且主语是名词时，谓语全部提前。

drill.stem: 只有经过足够的锻炼，你才能保持健康。
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Only after enough exercise can you keep fit.
drill.why: only + 状语句首，can 提前。

drill.stem: 我永远也忘记不了你对我和我的家人所表现出的善良和温暖。
cue: 用倒装句和定语从句翻译
drill.src: 2023 · 东华 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Never will I forget the kindness and warmth (that/which) you showed me and my family.
drill.why: Never 句首，will 提到 I 前。

drill.stem: 书法不仅是一种中国艺术形式，更是一种重要技能。
drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: Not only is calligraphy a form of Chinese art, but also an important skill.
drill.why: Not only 句首，is 提到主语前。

drill.stem: They not only introduced advanced technology, but also changed their views on how to develop economy. → ___ they ___ advanced technology, but also changed their views on how to develop economy.
drill.src: 2022 · 翰林 · 高一上期中
drill.why: not only 句首倒助动词 did。
